brief:
Belgium is funding a "green" satellite initiative that benefits Elbit Systems, an Israeli defense contractor, the Electronic Intifada reported. The project involves the Technion, Israel's national institute of technology, which develops military technologies alongside civilian applications.

The funding arrangement raises questions about the flow of European public money to Israeli defense enterprises. Advocates argue that Technion should be excluded from international academic partnerships due to its military research connections.
dek: Technion must be kicked out of all international partnerships.
title: Belgium funds satellite project benefiting Israeli weapons firm Elbit
